blind.description: A stylized two-tier wooden bench or display stand holding five pots of vibrant blooming flowers. The lower tier holds two pots containing coral-red buds and bright orange blossoms; the upper tier holds three pots filled with deep red roses, yellow and orange daisies, and white and purple daisies. The pots include grey metal buckets and banded wooden tubs. The model has clean, solid stylized geometry with hand-painted style textures, fully intact with no disconnected or melted elements.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a compact rectangular cluster of colorful flower blossoms—deep red, bright yellow, orange, and purple-and-white—interspersed with green leaves, framed slightly at the edges by the brown wooden display bench.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 2 feet tall (reaching around knee height on the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 feet wide by 2 feet deep.
